assessment_summary:
**Inspected:** /workspace (repo at pinned SHA 8b58a9f, root of the badge-api Go module), installed prerequisites (Go 1.26.4, make 4.3), build artifact /workspace/badge-api, configuration (.badge-api.yaml, .env, secrets/*), the running `make run`/`serve` process tree and log (/workspace/badge-api-serve.log), source code (pkg/api/server.go, middleware/config_refresh.go, config.go refresher, handler/repository_handler.go, cmd/check.go) to interpret behavior, and live HTTP endpoints.

**Checks performed:** (1) Confirmed prerequisites, binary, and server process/port 8080 (LISTEN in /proc/net/tcp6). (2) Verified remote-config pipeline: log shows config + 17 SVGs fetched from gitlab.opencode.de; /api/v1/info returns 200 with full gitClients and badge definitions; /api/v1/svg/{key} returns 200 with real SVG content; /metrics returns 200. (3) Executed the guide's documented core functionality myself: `SKIP_SAVE_TO_DATABASE=true ./badge-api check --repository https://gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-api` ran the complete observer pipeline against live GitLab and produced 16 badge-level reports (some Granted), exiting without fatal errors. (4) Ran `go test ./pkg/api/middleware/...` -> ok. (5) Triggered the API check endpoint (with percent-encoded repo URL, per the handler's PathUnescape logic) and confirmed the server log records 'successfully executed repository checks'.

**Limitations/observations:** (a) Token files are empty (installer's documented deviation; the placeholder token caused a 401 panic, so unauthenticated access was used). Consequence: `members/all` checks log 401 and DevGuard lookups log 'token is empty'; these degrade to missing-data statuses gracefully and the pipeline completes — full-fidelity checks would need a real GitLab PAT/DevGuard credentials. (b) Runtime concurrency characteristic: while a full check runs (~17 min under the unauthenticated ~100 req/min GitLab rate limit), the middleware holds an RLock for each request's duration; when the 10-min config refresher requested the write lock, all new requests (including /info) hung until the in-flight check released its RLock at 12:03. This is inherent to the shipped code (singleflight + RWMutex + rate-limited external API), not an installation defect: the server recovered instantly (all endpoints 200 in <5 ms) and the refresher then ran successfully. It was not independently reproducible pre-check because the pre-check server state was only ever observed responsive. (c) PostgreSQL was not started (guide marks it optional; serve doesn't require it; check uses SKIP_SAVE_TO_DATABASE=true). (d) The 307/404 seen on raw repo URLs is the Go mux's cleanPath behavior — the route expects the repository URL percent-encoded as one path segment (confirmed from handler source).

**Conclusion:** The installation is complete and operational per the guide: build works, config loads from the remote, the server serves the documented API surface, and the documented `check` CLI performs real badge evaluations end-to-end. Assessed outcome: success.
